# Rowla report

For guided reports, use [the issue chooser](https://github.com/sharifhsn/rowla/issues/new/choose).
For usage questions, use [Discussions](https://github.com/sharifhsn/rowla/discussions).
For security problems, use [private vulnerability reports](https://github.com/sharifhsn/rowla/security/advisories/new).

This fallback supports clients without GitHub issue forms. Remove private data before submission.

## Problem

Describe the problem or proposed improvement.

## Environment

Rowla version, macOS version, Apple Silicon or Intel, affected app, and display/Space setup.

## Reproduction

Steps, expected result, and actual result. Include available permission status for window-control or preview bugs.
